text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
“—And you know... Lately, my cheeks and 
all... have been feeling kind of dry.”

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
What should I do at times like this? 
...Right. Okay. Moisturize, and watch what 
I eat...—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...Understood, I'll try to be careful. 
...Yeah. Thank you, Mom.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Haaah... I hope it heals up soon...—
